semiconductor_relevance: High — Ningbo Yunde specializes in non-metallic precision components for semiconductor equipment, making it a key supplier in the industry.
summary: Ningbo Yunde Material Incorporation is a leading manufacturer of high-purity quartz and precision ceramic components used in semiconductor fabrication. The company focuses on R&D and production of consumables for various semiconductor processes, ensuring high precision and quality in its offerings.
capabilities: Production of semiconductor-grade quartz rings and windows
Manufacturing of complex-structure components for CVD and PVD equipment
Customization of components based on customer specifications

regional_presence.China: Ningbo Yunde is one of the largest Chinese-funded enterprises in the machining industry, with significant production capabilities in quartz machining.
